build_ApertusForCausalLM: build an ApertusForCausalLM model from a HuggingFace ApertusConfig for inference-only causal language modeling
create_ApertusDecoderLayer: create an ApertusDecoderLayer with self-attention, MLP, and dual RMSNorm for each transformer layer
run_ApertusModel_forward: run the ApertusModel forward pass with input_ids, positions, and forward batch for token generation
load_ApertusForCausalLM_weights: load HuggingFace weights into ApertusForCausalLM with QKV projection sharding and KV cache scale support
test_ApertusAttention_forward: test ApertusAttention forward pass with QKV projection, RMSNorm, RoPE positional encoding, and RadixAttention
